competitors.rationale: Verified on 2026-08-12 (C:FridgeChef). Solves the inventory input problem through photo recognition and recipe suggestions, but targets improvising individuals rather than households and lacks weekly planning or shopping list coordination.

competitors.pricing_summary: EUR 6.99/month or EUR 49.99/year (converted to EUR 4.17/month on annual plan)
competitors.rationale: Verified on 2026-07-30 (C:MealLoop). Directly addresses weekly meal planning, automatic grocery lists, and family sharing for households, but does not track existing inventory.
Last verified on 2024-11-05 (C:PlanPlate), so data is possibly outdated. Provides shared planning calendars for couples and flatmates, but lacks inventory awareness and automated list generation.
Verified on 2026-06-18 (C:PantryGenie). Strong focus on waste reduction, pantry tracking via barcode scanning, and expiry alerts with a shopping list, but lacks weekly dinner planning.

competitors.pricing_summary: Free; EUR 29.99 one-off for full recipe pack
competitors.rationale: Verified on 2026-05-02 but lacks a source URL, making details unsourced (C:WeekWise). Competes on budget-focused meal plans and price comparisons for families, but lacks inventory integration.

Last verified on 2025-01-20 via homepage rather than a pricing page, so data is possibly outdated (C:ZeroWaste Kitchen). Offers leftover use-it-up recipes for environmental cooks, but does not provide structured weekly planning or household coordination.
Verified on 2026-08-25 (C:SupperSync). Directly targets shared households with collaborative dinner planning, chore rotas, and shared shopping lists, though it lacks inventory awareness.

white_space: No single competitor bridges the gap between inventory awareness and weekly dinner planning. Apps either know inventory without generating structured weekly plans (C:FridgeChef, C:PantryGenie, C:ZeroWaste Kitchen) or generate weekly plans and grocery lists without accounting for items already in stock (C:MealLoop, C:PlanPlate, C:WeekWise, C:SupperSync).
No competitor combines household collaborative coordination and shared shopping lists with existing pantry inventory tracking (C:PantryGenie, C:SupperSync, C:MealLoop).
pricing_anchors: Competitor subscription prices range from EUR 2.99/month (C:PlanPlate) to EUR 6.99/month (or EUR 4.17/month annualized) (C:MealLoop), with household-specific tools charging EUR 4.49/month (C:SupperSync) and pantry trackers charging EUR 3.99/month (C:PantryGenie). Consumer willingness to pay is anchored at a median of EUR 3.50 per month (S05). Any pricing hypothesis above EUR 6.99/month is untested and outside empirical anchors.

idea_claim_checks.claim: Existing recipe apps give ideas but do not know what you already own.
idea_claim_checks.explanation: Multiple existing competitors specifically track or recognize inventory: FridgeChef identifies ingredients via fridge photos (C:FridgeChef), PantryGenie monitors pantry stock and expiry dates via barcodes (C:PantryGenie), and ZeroWaste Kitchen provides recipes based on leftover ingredients (C:ZeroWaste Kitchen). PantryPal's true differentiation lies in combining inventory awareness with weekly planning, not in inventory awareness alone.

idea_claim_checks.claim: Dinner planning is a daily chore, groceries are expensive, and a lot of food gets thrown away.
idea_claim_checks.explanation: Households discard 19% of the food they purchase (S01), weekly groceries average EUR 118 for a two-person household (S02), and adults spend 22 minutes daily deciding what to cook based on 2023 time-use data (S04).
